item.title: Insights from Breast Cancer Patients: What They Want You to Know
Robin Roberts Reflects on Breast Cancer, Self-Advocacy, and Trusting Her Instincts

item.title: The Health Advantages of a Morning Walk
Inflammatory blood markers may predict COVID-19 outcomes in younger patients only
item.description: A study found that inflammatory indices in emergency COVID-19 patients predicted 30-day mortality in younger adults but not in older ones.
